vision.one_line: Choose whether dropped attachments become links or embeds by file extension.
vision.north_star: Dropped attachments always use the link or embed syntax the user expects while native attachment handling remains intact.
vision.promise: PDF and office references can stay compact links, images and media can remain embeds, and unlisted extensions keep native behavior.

principles.title: Agent-verifiable repository
principles.rule: Behavior, release contracts, and proof must be reproducible from a fresh clone without relying on chat history.

principles.title: Structured contracts first
principles.rule: Machine-consumable project and verification contracts use JSON or JSONL; Markdown provides human context.
bad: prose as the only source of truth

principles.title: Native attachment handling
principles.rule: The app owns attachment storage, duplicate-name resolution, destination, exact drop position, and Wiki or Markdown link formatting.

principles.title: Public surfaces only
principles.rule: Use documented plugin, editor, workspace, and DOM surfaces without monkeypatching internal components.

principles.title: Rewrite only the current drop
principles.rule: Existing links and unrelated note content must never be changed.

principles.title: Unknown means native
principles.rule: Extensions absent from both configured lists keep the syntax generated by the app.
bad: force every extension into one mode

non_goals: Read attachment contents or send telemetry

acceptance_scorecard.question: Do PDF drops become normal links under default settings?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Unit and Electron runtime smoke prove `![[report.pdf]]` becomes `[[report.pdf]]`.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Do image drops become embeds under default settings?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Unit and Electron runtime smoke prove `[[diagram.png]]` becomes `![[diagram.png]]`.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Does the repository catch known Community review failures locally?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Manifest, lifecycle, API-version, settings-heading, id/name uniqueness, build, and release checks pass.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Does the plugin preserve native attachment ownership?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: The plugin does not consume `editor-drop` and changes only the newly inserted marker.

review_checklist: Verify release assets are exactly main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css
Verify manifest description avoids the word Obsidian
Verify no private or production vault data is included

maturity_model.meaning: Vision, source, settings, documentation, and release contract exist.
Core behavior, boundary cases, lint, typecheck, build, and Community preflight pass.
The built plugin is loaded and proven in the Windows-local Electron test vault.

residual_risk_wording: The automated smoke proves the loaded runtime and both marker directions with synthetic editor insertion. Final Community submission still requires the external directory review process.
